units.source_text: 美国兵来到池畔，视野开阔了，他张开两臂喊了几句什么，于是扬起了一阵欢笑声。

en.t: When the American soldier came to the edge of the pond and the view opened out, he spread both arms and shouted something, and a burst of laughter rose up.

units.source_text: 他粗野地摇晃着女人的身体。

en.t: He was roughly shaking the woman's body.

units.source_text: 女人皱着眉头，又说一声：

en.t: The woman frowned and said once more:
